resources.string: Connect an MCP server by URL or JSON. For supported services, sign in through your browser.
Choose a verified remote service to prefill its details. Save and authorize it before using its tools. Other servers can be added with +.
The service URL has been prefilled. Review it, then sign in via your browser if the server supports it. Saving alone does not verify the connection.
Choose a provider to prefill its API endpoint. Add your own key; free tiers, limits and billing depend on the provider. You can edit the address and model list.
